task_context.problem_statement: Mark has 30 candies, Peter has 25 candies, and John has 35 candies. They decided to combine their candies together and share them equally. How many candies will each one of them have?
task_context.reference_solution:
The total number of the candies is 30 + 25 + 35 = <<30+25+35=90>>90.
When the candies are shared equally each one will get 90 / 3 = <<90/3=30>>30.
#### 30
